channel.title: Fin Planning Pod
channel.description: A daily 4-5 minute podcast opening up one real Indian money story at a time, from the Fin Planning Pod video library: income, spending, investments and portfolio, rupee by rupee.

item.title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 1 — The 82 Lakh Warangal Plan
item.description: Mimi and Alex open up Jitender's money story from Warangal: 82.8 lakh from salary, freelancing and rent, 1.88 lakh invested every month, and a 2.05 crore portfolio built from a 6,000 rupee first salary.
